ModuleMetaData.DescriptionHeadline: OGRE Assimp converter: converts the model formats of Assimp to .mesh, .skeleton and .material
ModuleMetaData.DescriptionDetails: OgreAssimpConverter of OGRE 14.6.3, a command line tool that converts any model format of the module assimp (glTF, FBX, Collada, OBJ, ...) to the native .mesh, .skeleton and .material files. It runs without a render system. The converter is linked with OgreCodec_Assimp and installs its plugin object itself, see the edit marked DV edit in main.cpp.
